newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to sell late-April Madras naphtha.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to sell late-April Madras naphtha.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) offered to sell by tender 27,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha (LAN) lifting April 21-25 free-on-board Madras on the east coast, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender closes on April 10 and bid will be valid for one day.

IOC's last LAN tender from the east coast, lifting Vizag during mid-April, was awarded at $25 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes on an fob basis, while its last Madras LAN cargo, lifting January 27-29, was awarded at a $23-to-$24 discount.
